Name: Kitchen Stations Set KSS
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/sJ9yWYy/Mod-Cover.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]Ever had clutter from the recipes in your kitchen?

No more![/size]


Kitchen stations for your every need (and categorized in a very biased way by me :D)
Accessible in your farmhouse maps!
(General Kitchen Menu is in the sink - toggable too!)


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gdV4wJC/information-on-stations.png[/img]
[size=3]Now with Big Craftables included![/size]

Includes the following kitchen stations:
[spoiler]
The main counters are sold by Robin for 1500g after the first house upgrade.
(You'll receive a letter the day after the house upgrade is done, so they then appear in stock!)

[spoiler]
[b]Cocktail Bar:[/b] alcoholic beverages
*Please note that the Cocktail Bar may be empty due to there being no alcoholic beverages in the vanilla kitchen...*
[b]Dessert Station: [/b]sweet stuff considered a dessert
[b]Drink and Snack Bar:[/b] non-alcoholic beverages, snack, and anything to make a snack (sauces and dips), as well as spices!
[b]Kitchen Counter:[/b] preparing meals that don't require to be hot, or would rather have them cool off (this is very subjective :D)
[b]Induction Oven and Stove:[/b] preparing meals that require to be hot
[b]Sushi Bar:[/b] everything sushi (and ceviches)
[/spoiler]

A [b]Festival Delights[/b] counter, is a special one for is available at Sandy's for 1000g!
(Robin will later have it but at 2000g because imports from the desert are expensive sometimes :| )
[spoiler]
For Wizadroid's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21303]Desert Festival Foods[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url] foods!
Now with added [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27990]Mid Autumn Festival Mooncakes[/url] tab.
And a Holiday foods tab!
[/spoiler]


A [b]Simple Sink[/b] makes it way to Robin's for 2000g. (Once you've earned that money :) of course)
Its just a sink, or is it?
[spoiler]This is a general kitchen menu![/spoiler]

Another special craftable!
An [b]Adamantine Cooking Pot[/b] (fire included) for your [s]dungeon[/s] mine meals~
[spoiler]
For the delicious recipes in [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23211]Delicious in Stardew[/url].
Sold by Marlon for 1500g after receiving a letter from him!
Don't forget to prove your worth to him.

Now including recipes from: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]Dwarven Expansion[/url], and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36062]Bug Meat Bonanza[/url]!
[/spoiler]

A special craftable!
A [b]Melting Pot[/b] (fire also included) for a wide variety of world meals~
[spoiler]
For delicious recipes in [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28734]The Melting Pot[/url]
Sold be Robin for 1500g after receiving her letter (like some other craftables!)
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[size=2]Now with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]AT[/url] add-on![/size]
Don't want to change all the wood coloring in one go on a pesky config?
Get a paint bucket and color them on your own!
[spoiler]
v1.2.0 AT adds around 159 textures - 44 for the stove~ And visuals to appear looking left or right :D
v1.3.0 AT adds tracking and finally fixing some stuff
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img]
Some compatibilities are done for some farmhouse mods~
As well as some mods that include recipes!
Check them out to see if this mod is compatible with any you might be using ><
[i]*For farmhouses, if its not on the list, it might not be compatible especially if it greatly alters the position and size of the original kitchen(s)*[/i]

[i]*Compatibility patches have been made for farmhouse maps, attempting not to modify their intended layout*
*All mods linked under recipes only use the recipe name entry to add them into the station, nothing else is touched or uploaded*[/i]

[spoiler]
[size=3]----- Recolours -----[/size]
[spoiler]
The farmhouse option should work with any recolor as the patches use vanilla tiles!

For recolours with the big craftables see the AT optional folder as it tries to cover the some colour palettes.
(There is also the option to change the colours through the config but it is more rigid)
[/spoiler]

[size=3]----- FarmHouses -----
[/size]No assets from these mods are used, only an overlay patch is applied.
If a mod uses their own assets for the kitchen, it is unlikely I will add compatibility.
Now needing Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url])

[spoiler]
[b]Enable in Farmhouse:[/b] Enables Better Crafting's kitchen stations made for the farmhouse map. Kitchen Sink option has all kitchen menu.
[b]Enable in Island Farmhouse: [/b]Enables Better Crafting's kitchen stations made for the island farmhouse map.
[b]Enable Craftables:[/b] Enables Better Crafting's kitchen stations made for big craftables.
[b]Exclusive to Menu:[/b] Means that the menu's created have kidnapped the recipes and these won't appear in the general kitchen menu. Disable so your own categories can appear in the general kitchen menu. (Default is disabled)
[b]Override Detection Area BC:[/b] Overrides the chosen detection area in Better Crafting with this mods one for the big craftables. (12 tiles). Does not affect general menu in sink if enabled.
[b]Override Detection Area Map:[/b] Overrides the chosen detection area in Better Crafting with this mods one map stations (20 tiles). Does not affect general menu in sink if enabled.
[b]Magic Sink:[/b] For those that disable kitchen but still want the a misc. menu, here is a special craftable for you. A simple sink. MUST have craftables enabled.
[b]Top Kitchen Only:[/b] Toggles between only top kitchen area showing menus only or including other stations in the side cabinets (counters?) in kitchen area.
[b]Kitchen Sink Menu: [/b]Toggles if Main Kitchen menu is available in the farmhouse kitchen sink so all recipes that are not compatible yet can appear. Setting it true will make it appear!

[b]Darker Stove:[/b] Whether stove has darker metal shading. Default is false.
[b]Wood Colour:[/b] Choose the wood color style! The options are Vanilla, or Black, Dark, Brown, Light, or White wood recolouring to the counter.
[spoiler]
Vanilla
Black Wood
Dark Wood
Brown Wood
Light Brown Wood
White Wood
[/spoiler]
[b]Tile Colour:[/b] Choose the tiles color style! White, Blue, Green, and Vanilla Gray tiles recolouring to the counter.
[spoiler]
White
Blue
Green
Vanilla Gray-ish
[/spoiler]
[b]Decorations:[/b] Choose whether you want the decorations on or off for specific big craftables!
[spoiler]
Kitchen Counter
Drink and Snack Bar
Induction Oven and Stove
Dessert Station
Cocktail Bar
Sushi Bar
Festival Delights Counter
A Simple Sink
[/spoiler]

[b]Compatibility with Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Buildables:[/b] If toggled, some of the functional furniture in the buildable kitchen will have access to the Induction Oven and Stove menu, some of the functional furniture in the buildable bakery and cafe will have access to the Dessert Station menu. Does not affect sink like furniture having the general menu.

[b]No Kitchen: [/b]For compatibility with mods that change farmhouse appearance and removes kitchen. Please set as true if in THEIR mod you have disabled the kitchen.
[b]Lune's Small Kitchen:[/b] For compatibility with Lune Farmhouse. Please set this as true if in THEIR mod you have set the farmhouse style to small.
[b]Compatibility with Kitchen Size for Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Farmhouse[/b]: For compatibility with Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Farmhouse. Please set this to the same config as in THEIR mod so the compatibility can be synced.
